title: Multi-metric Eval Sentinels for Canary & Shadow Traffic
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Deliver a production-ready multi-metric sentinel system that evaluates canary and shadowed model traffic against configurable golden prompt sets (scorecards) and executes automated rollback or pause policies when regressions exceed policy thresholds. The goal is to reduce silent quality regressions during staged rollouts while keeping operational overhead (false positives, cost) acceptable for high-throughput customers.
comments: 2026-02-28 - Aisha Patel: Initial scoping — design doc linked. Proposed combining semantic similarity (embedding-based) + task-specific metrics (BLEU/ROUGE for structured outputs, hallucination detectors) into a composite score. Need input from infra on eval throughput cost.

2026-03-03 - Daniel Kim: Infra feasibility review — realtime evaluation of every request is too expensive. Propose sampled golden-probe stream (configurable sample rate) + async replayer to run heavier checks. Will prototype with 5% shadowed traffic in staging.
2026-03-05 - PM review (Lena Ortiz): Acceptable risk profile: must support per-customer sensitivity. Add per-customer thresholds and mute windows for known noisy workloads.
2026-03-08 - Design (Maya Singh): UX note — expose composite score and per-metric deltas in rollout dashboard. Provide synthetic stream generator UI for QA to reproduce regressions.
2026-03-10 - Daniel Kim: Implemented prototype sentinel service + kinesis-backed golden stream. Unit tests added for composite score aggregation. Opened PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4125.
2026-03-12 - SRE (Priya Rao): Load test results attached — with sampling 3% the extra egress and CPU are within limits. Need autoscaler rules for sentinel workers when sampling > 5%.
2026-03-12 - Action item: finalize policy DSL for gating (see acceptance criteria) and begin integration with rollout controller for hard pause + automated rollback paths.
acceptance_criteria: Sentinel can ingest canary and shadow traffic and evaluate against configured golden prompt sets with composite metric computed within 5s of ingestion for sampled requests.
Composite score is composed of at least three orthogonal metrics (semantic similarity, factuality/hallucination score, and task-specific quality) and exposed in the console per-rollout.

Policy DSL supports: threshold on composite score drop, sustained delta over sliding window (configurable 1m/5m/1h), per-customer sensitivity, and probabilistic gating (e.g., 1-in-N enforcement) for low-frequency customers.

Automatic rollback/pause triggers a documented orchestration path in the rollout controller and produces an incident with root-cause candidate examples (golden prompts + model outputs) to the rollout timeline.
False positive alarm rate < 2% on synthetic-noise tests and end-to-end CI tests that simulate non-regression traffic.
Dashboards and alerting: per-rollout time-series for each metric, composite score, and an alert channel integration (PagerDuty/Slack) with runbook link.
Performance: sentinel evaluation pipeline additional P50 latency < 200ms for sampled sync probes; heavier async checks complete within 60s and do not block traffic.
Security: no customer PII is sent to public eval endpoints; KMS used for golden set storage where required (flagged per-customer).
implementation_steps: 1) Finalize policy DSL and config schema for rollouts (fields: sample_rate, composite_weights, sliding_window, severity, mute_windows, enforcement_mode).
2) Build sentinel microservice that accepts shadowed/canary samples, computes lightweight metrics synchronously, and enqueues heavier checks to async workers.
3) Create golden-prompt registry with per-customer tagging, versioning, and KMS-backed storage.
4) Integrate sentinel outputs with rollout-controller via events (SENTINEL_ALERT, SENTINEL_CLEAR) and define rollback orchestration steps.
5) Implement dashboard panels in Console: scorecard heatmap, per-metric deltas, example-driven investigation view with links to replayer.
6) Add autoscaling rules for sentinel workers and circuit-breaker to stop evaluation if quota is exceeded.
7) Run end-to-end canary in staging with synthetic golden streams and monitor false positive rate; iterate composite weights.
8) Deliver runbook and onboarding guide for PMs/SEs: configuring thresholds, interpreting scorecards, and request review hooks.
9) Production rollout: opt-in beta for 5 customers, collect telemetry for 2 weeks, then enable wide default at sampling 1%.
